title: ForTy 2020, UTM zone 3 north (EPSG:32603)
description: Nature Trace Forest Typology 2020 (v1) tiles in UTM zone 3 north (EPSG:32603): per-class probabilities of five forest types at 10 m, one COG per tile, mirrored unchanged from Figshare+ by Epoch. See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the encoding and quirks.

providers.name: Epoch
providers.description: Hosts this mirror on Source Cooperative.

sci:publications.citation: Neumann, M., et al. (2026). Global forest typology at 10-meter resolution for forest and land-use monitoring. EarthArXiv preprint.

bands.name: primary_forest
bands.description: Probability of class 0 "Primary forest", 0 to 250. Multiply by 1/250 for a probability in [0, 1].

bands.name: naturally_regenerating_forest
bands.description: Probability of class 1 "Naturally regenerating forest", 0 to 250. Multiply by 1/250 for a probability in [0, 1].

bands.name: planted_forest
bands.description: Probability of class 2 "Planted forest", 0 to 250. Multiply by 1/250 for a probability in [0, 1].

bands.name: plantation_forest
bands.description: Probability of class 3 "Plantation forest", 0 to 250. Multiply by 1/250 for a probability in [0, 1].

bands.name: tree_crops_and_agroforestry
bands.description: Probability of class 4 "Tree crops and agroforestry", 0 to 250. Multiply by 1/250 for a probability in [0, 1].

classification:classes.name: other_land
classification:classes.title: Other land
classification:classes.description: Implicit: 250 minus the sum of the five bands; no band in the file.

footprints.title: ForTy 2020, UTM zone 3 north (EPSG:32603) item footprints (vector tiles)
